erddapDatasets.theShortDescriptionHtml:
EMSO Dataset Examples

This page contains a set of dataset examples following the EMSO Metadata Specifications. These examples demonstrate proper metadata formatting and structure for EMSO data products, ensuring consistency and interoperability across the research infrastructure.

Useful Links

  • EMSO Metadata Specifications: The normative document with the rules on how to create EMSO-compliant NetCDF and ERDDAP datasets
  • Metadata Harmonizer Toolbox: contains several tools o creates and evaluate NetCDF datasets in compliance with EMSO Metadata Specifications. It also includes tools to integrate NetCDF files into an ERDDAP server
  • Configuration of this ERDDAP server: Contains all the configuration and datasets shown in this page.
